<subject>Aerospace Parts Procurement 2024</subject>
<body>
My name is Andrea Reeves and I am the Vice President for Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.  I know that you were involved in the procurement of aerospace components for our Manufacturing unit last year.  I do not have confirmation as to who the procurement leads are for your teams this year.  Will you please respond to this email and let me know if you are a procurement lead for a team this year?  If you are not your team's procurement lead, would you please (if you know) tell me who is this year's lead (please include the team numbers in your return email.  I have sent out three emails to the procurement team today and would like to get the information to your team's lead as soon as possible.  Thanks for your help!
</body>
<quoted>
</quoted>
